# Upstream link context

The immutable `upstream/README.md` snapshot contains the relative link
`../.github/workflows/lean-projects.yml`. The adjacent workflow file is the
byte-preserved file from the same pinned `anthropics/formal-math` revision; it
is included outside `upstream/` only so that the bundled snapshot's relative
link remains navigable in the private candidate archive. It is not executed by
Xylem and is not part of the 265-file source snapshot.
